neutral.EN: Jesus... I actually hit it.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko... tinamaan ko talaga.

neutral.EN: My hands are shaking... but it's down.
neutral.TL: Nanginginig ang mga kamay ko... pero bagsak na.

neutral.EN: Did I get it? God, I think it's dead.
neutral.TL: Napatay ko ba? Diyos ko, sa tingin ko patay na.

neutral.EN: That was way too close...
neutral.TL: Masyadong malapit 'yon...

neutral.EN: I panicked and fired... thank God.
neutral.TL: Nag-panic ako at bumaril... salamat sa Diyos.

neutral.EN: Is it dead? Please tell me it's dead.
neutral.TL: Patay na ba? Sabihin mo sa akin kung patay na.

neutral.EN: Heart's beating out of my chest...
neutral.TL: Lulukso ang puso ko sa kaba...

neutral.EN: I didn't think that shot would land.
neutral.TL: Hindi ko akalaing tatama ang putok na 'yon.

neutral.EN: It's down... don't let another one get close.
neutral.TL: Bagsak na... huwag mong hayaang may makalapit pang iba.

neutral.EN: God... that sound... it's finally quiet.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko... ang tunog na 'yon... tahimik na rin sa wakas.

neutral.EN: Oh God... there's blood everywhere.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko... may dugo kahit saan.

neutral.EN: It's in pieces... I need a second.
neutral.TL: Pira-piraso na... kailangan ko ng saglit.

neutral.EN: The smell... God, I think I'm gonna be sick.
neutral.TL: Ang amoy... Diyos ko, masusuka yata ako.

neutral.EN: I can still feel the crunch...
neutral.TL: Ramdam ko pa rin ang lagutok...

neutral.EN: It came right at me... had to cut it.
neutral.TL: Diretso sa akin... kailangan kong hiwain.

neutral.EN: Hands won't stop trembling...
neutral.TL: Ayaw tumigil ng panginginig ng mga kamay ko...

neutral.EN: Is it really dead? Look at it...
neutral.TL: Patay na ba talaga? Tingnan mo...

neutral.EN: That was horrible... but it's over.
neutral.TL: Kakila-kilabot 'yon... pero tapos na.

neutral.EN: God, I hate doing this...
neutral.TL: Diyos ko, ayaw na ayaw kong ginagawa 'to...

neutral.EN: Head's gone... let's just step back.
neutral.TL: Wala nang ulo... umatras muna tayo.

neutral.EN: Oh God. I did that with my hands.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko. Kamay ko lang ang ginamit ko.

neutral.EN: I had to shove it down... my bare hands.
neutral.TL: Kinailangan kong itulak pabagsak... mga kamay ko lang.

neutral.EN: It almost bit me. Look at my arms shaking.
neutral.TL: Halos makagat ako. Tingnan mo ang nanginginig kong braso.

neutral.EN: I need a weapon. I can't do that again.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko ng sandata. Hindi ko na mauulit 'yon.

neutral.EN: I felt its teeth scrape near my jacket.
neutral.TL: Naramdaman ko ang ngipin nito malapit sa jacket ko.

neutral.EN: Stomped on its head... God forgive me.
neutral.TL: Tinapakan ko ang ulo... patawarin ako ng Diyos.

neutral.EN: That was pure desperation.
neutral.TL: Dala lang 'yon ng matinding takot.

neutral.EN: My hands are bruised... but I'm alive.
neutral.TL: Pasa-pasa ang mga kamay ko... pero buhay pa ako.

neutral.EN: Never want to be that close again.
neutral.TL: Ayoko nang mapalapit nang gano'n kailanman.

neutral.EN: It's dead... I pushed it off and stomped.
neutral.TL: Patay na... itinulak ko at tinapakan.
